title: Venice Study
subtitle: Architectural line illustration
description: An architectural line illustration studying the structure, rhythm, and texture of Venice.

components.heading: Venice Study
paragraphs: Venice Study is an architectural illustration focused on the density, rhythm, and accumulated detail of the city’s built environment.
The drawing uses line weight and selective contrast to separate structural layers while preserving the visual complexity that makes the subject distinctive.
This focused mockup treats the single finished work as an object worth examining at scale, with room to add sketches or process material later.

components.quote: “Line becomes a way to measure the city’s rhythm.”
